_comment: Scenario matrix for the synthetic MFC2-like dataset (generate_synthetic_real_mirror.py, dataset 'mfc2_synthetic'); run by tests/test_pipeline_mfc2_synthetic.py (marker slow) with --dataset mfc2_synthetic; one axis changes per scenario relative to mfc2_syn_base.
Data paths come from --dataset; output_dir is overridden by the test (tmp dir).
rolling_mean_window=null: emagpy's rolling mean also averages the x/y of the window, which on a thinned survey (points tens of metres apart) moves points away from the TDR stations.

mfc2_syn_base.description: Synthetic MFC2 twin, base: single interface at 0.225 m (2 layers, matches 15/30 cm TDR), CS forward model, pooled Waxman-Smits with 2 free parameters (sigma_w, sigma_s; a and m fixed), no train/validation split. EM cleaning: rolling mean and percentile filter OFF (they move/drop the few points near the TDR stations of a thinned survey).

mfc2_syn_free3.description: Pooled WS, K=3 free parameters (m, sigma_w, sigma_s).

mfc2_syn_free4.description: Pooled WS, K=4 free parameters (all). Start a=0.6 (a=0.5 is its lower bound, members would pile up there).

mfc2_syn_kern_below.description: Localized (kernel) WS calibration, bandwidth 15 m (below the ~40 m station spacing).

mfc2_syn_kern_at.description: Localized (kernel) WS calibration, bandwidth 40 m (at the ~40 m station spacing).

mfc2_syn_kern_above.description: Localized (kernel) WS calibration, bandwidth 100 m (above the ~40 m station spacing).

mfc2_syn_tv_probe.description: Train/validation split by_probe (whole stations held out).

mfc2_syn_tv_time.description: Train/validation split by_time_block (whole time steps held out; needs >= 2 epochs).

mfc2_syn_sub_probes.description: EM subsample: keep points within 5 m of a TDR probe.

mfc2_syn_sub_grid.description: EM subsample: one point per 20 m cell.

mfc2_syn_fslin.description: Inversion with FSlin (use with a dataset built with truth_forward_model='FSlin' to avoid the inverse crime).

mfc2_syn_two_interfaces.description: Two interfaces (0.10 m and 0.225 m, 3 layers); the top layer has no TDR probe.
